definitions.rationale: Expands the named digitsCond proof term into the translated AST expression for n > 0.
Expands the named digitsLoopBody proof term into the exact translated statement sequence used by the loop.
definitions.text:
rule digitsLoopBody
    => Assign(Name("digit"), BinOp("%", Name("n"), Int(10)))
       If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("digit"), Int(2)),
                  CmpOp("==", Int(1))),
          If(Compare(Name("result"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
             Assign(Name("result"), Name("digit")),
             Assign(Name("result"),
                    BinOp("*", Name("result"), Name("digit")))),
          .Stmts)
       Assign(Name("n"), BinOp("//", Name("n"), Int(10)))

definitions.rationale: Defines SolutionProgram as the closed constructor term for the translated digits implementation.
definitions.text:
rule SolutionProgram
    => Module(
         FuncDef("digits", Params("n"),
           Assign(Name("result"), Int(0))
           While(digitsCond, digitsLoopBody)
           Return(Name("result"))))

definitions.rationale: Defines the even-digit case of addOddDigit, leaving the accumulated product unchanged.
definitions.text:
rule addOddDigit(A, D) => A
    requires D %Int 2 ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the first-odd-digit case of addOddDigit when the zero sentinel is still present.
definitions.text:
rule addOddDigit(A, D) => D
    requires (D %Int 2 =/=Int 0) andBool (A ==Int 0)

definitions.rationale: Defines the subsequent-odd-digit case of addOddDigit by multiplying the accumulator by the digit.
definitions.text:
rule addOddDigit(A, D) => A *Int D
    requires (D %Int 2 =/=Int 0) andBool (A =/=Int 0)

definitions.rationale: Defines the base case of the oddProductFrom digit-fold recurrence.
definitions.text:
rule oddProductFrom(N, A) => A
    requires N <=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the recursive case of oddProductFrom by consuming one base-10 digit and updating the accumulator.
definitions.text:
rule oddProductFrom(N, A)
    => oddProductFrom(N /Int 10, addOddDigit(A, N %Int 10))
    requires N >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines oddProduct as oddProductFrom initialized with the zero sentinel.
Defines the base case of finalScratchDigit, preserving the current scratch value when no digits remain.
definitions.text:
rule finalScratchDigit(N, D) => D
    requires N <=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the recursive case of finalScratchDigit by tracking the digit written during each remaining loop iteration.
definitions.text:
rule finalScratchDigit(N, _D)
    => finalScratchDigit(N /Int 10, N %Int 10)
    requires N >Int 0

operational_rules.rationale: Observes structural identity of two program terms and emits ProgramsMatch for the launcher check; it is not an additional mathematical fact.
